Software Engineer – Early Career Digital Technology Rising Leaders Program
Farmington, CT
Full-time

$70K/yr - $80K/yr
Otis Elevator Co. is an elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, and service company. The Software Engineer in the Digital Technology Rising Leaders Program will complete three rotations involving software engineering and field operations while developing, testing, deploying, and supporting Compass product software. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams, investigating software issues, and preparing for a permanent software engineering position.
Construction

Responsibilities
Develop, test, release, and maintain software for the Compass product line
Build experience across Linux-based systems, embedded platforms, application software, automated testing, and supporting tools
Complete three eight-month rotations designed to prepare you for a long-term software engineering role
Partner with field service teams during one rotation to understand how Compass solutions are installed, operated, supported, and maintained in customer environments
Translate observations from site visits and ride-alongs into product requirements, usability improvements, and support recommendations
Create user guides, tutorials, and other resources that make product deployment and adoption easier for field teams, building teams, users, and customers
Investigate software issues, support upgrades and field tests, and help identify root causes in operating environments
Collaborate with engineering, product management, quality assurance, sales, customer support, and building stakeholders to improve the end-to-end product experience
Write clean, maintainable, testable code and contribute to code reviews and team planning
Present rotation goals, progress, lessons learned, and outcomes to program and technology leaders, then apply feedback to strengthen your work

Required
Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field, which must be completed by the June 2027 start date timeframe
Coursework, project experience, or practical experience with one or more programming languages, such as Python, C, C++, Java, or Go
Foundational understanding of software development, testing, troubleshooting, version control, or Linux-based environments
Ability to learn quickly, ask thoughtful questions, take initiative, and adapt across engineering, field, product, and customer-facing assignments
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain progress, findings, and recommendations to technical and nontechnical partners
Preferred
Experience in embedded software is a plus

401(k) plan that includes generous company match and a separate automatic retirement contribution
Comprehensive medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage for colleagues and their eligible dependents, beginning on their first day of employment

Peer recognition and service anniversary awards, as well as spot performance bonus opportunities
Structured rotations, mentorship, formal professional development, exposure to leaders across the organization, and hands-on work on a globally used product
Defined path toward a permanent software engineering role upon successful completion of the program
